title: Vietnamese-Style Coconut Sweet Potato and Tofu Curry
summary: A fragrant vegan coconut curry inspired by Vietnamese flavours, with tender sweet potato, crisp-edged tofu and green vegetables in a gently spiced coconut broth. It is warming, colourful and ideal for an easy dinner with rice.

ingredients.name: sweet potato, peeled and cut into 2 cm chunks

steps: Rinse the rice, then cook it according to the packet instructions so it is ready when the curry is finished.

Pat the tofu dry. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat, add the tofu cubes and fry for 6–8 minutes, turning occasionally, until lightly golden on several sides. Lift onto a plate.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp oil to the pan. Add the onion and cook for 4–5 minutes until softened and just starting to colour.
Stir in the garlic, ginger and chilli and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the curry powder and turmeric and stir for 30 seconds so the spices bloom in the oil.

Add the sweet potato and carrot, then pour in the coconut milk and vegetable stock. Stir in the tamari, salt and black pepper. Bring to a simmer, cover loosely and cook for 15–18 minutes until the sweet potato is almost tender when pierced with a knife.
Return the tofu to the pan and add the green beans. Simmer uncovered for 5 minutes until the beans are bright green and tender-crisp and the sauce has thickened slightly.
Stir in the bok choy and cook for 2–3 minutes until wilted but still fresh-looking. Turn off the heat and stir in the lime juice.
Taste and adjust with a little more salt or lime juice if needed. Scatter with fresh coriander and serve hot with the rice.
